edits.new:
| TC-S6-E6010-APP-03 | BR5 | Component | Each table of section 12.7 is exercised at its boundary: debt_sale_account is only read, no column of debt_sale_lot is written, decision_record and idempotency_key are the only objects written, outbox_event receives no row, and no cross-schema join or foreign key is used |
| TC-S6-E6010-APP-04 | AC3, X6 | Boundary | A pipeline statement or component that reaches `rwb_case`, `rwb_decision`, `rwb_access`, `rwb_deviation` or another service's schema is refused by the grant and fails the build |
| TC-S6-E6010-APP-05 | BR1 | Component | The step writes no recovery_case row, state, task or timer; it answers the closure to rwb-case only |
| TC-S6-E6010-APP-06 | BR2 | Component | The decision record is written with the rule ID and the package version before the closure answer leaves; a failed write changes nothing and returns MSG-P7-003 |
| TC-S6-E6010-APP-07 | BR3 | Component | The step starts only on the award confirmation of the lot and is bounded by the same-day timer of R-UNI-47; no screen, batch or schedule starts it |
| TC-S6-E6010-APP-08 | BR5 | Component | No cross-schema join or foreign key leaves rwb_debtsale; buyer_partner_id and account_id are identifiers of other services' facts |
| TC-S6-E6010-APP-09 | BR6 | Component | Each value a business person may change is read as reference data or a rule row with its version; none is hard-coded |
| TC-S6-E6010-APP-10 | BR7 | Contract | The story declares no REST operation; the closure element is read through API-S6-002 and API-S6-003 is not provided here |
| TC-S6-E6010-APP-11 | BR8 | Component | The same award signal, closure answer or Idempotency-Key twice closes once, answers once and counts the repeat |
| TC-S6-E6010-APP-12 | BR9 | Component | No person name, identity number, date of birth, contact value or unmasked account identifier appears in rwb_debtsale, the decision record, a log or a workflow input |
| TC-S6-E6010-APP-13 | BR10 | Contract | The staff screen reads the closure element through the gateway-bff composite route only; no screen calls a service directly |
| TC-S6-E6010-APP-14 | BR11 | Component | The AWARD_CONFIRMED signal of R-DS-23 is the only trigger of the closure step |
| TC-S6-E6010-APP-15 | BR12 | Component | R-UNI-47 is evaluated with the package in force; the data transfer and the posting are not executed by this step |
| Contract dependencies | rwb-decision (P7), the rules component the package in force is read from; rwb-case (P3); rwb-access (P4) |

edits.old: Workflow, one execution per lot, the child of `CaseWorkflow` on rwb-case (P3), a saga with pivot = transfer and continues-as-new across the settlement and the put-back window
edits.new: Workflow, one execution per lot identified by its lot number, the stage workflow of the case for eligibility and the case-side steps and the saga of the lot for the sale steps, with pivot = transfer and continues-as-new across the settlement and the put-back window; the case side is moved by rwb-case on `LotAwarded` and `AccountsTransferred`, never by a write into the case schema

edits.old: No child workflow for the case and no workflow for the money exists in this service.
edits.new: The case-side steps run inside `DebtSaleWorkflow` as the stage workflow of the case, and the sale steps as the saga of the lot; no workflow for the money exists in this service.

edits.old: this story owns the closure step alone.
edits.new: this story owns the closure step alone. The step declares no provided operation and no adapter: it is started by the signal API-S6-003 of RWB-S6-E6005-APP, runs unattended under the rwb-debtsale service identity, and the derecognition and posting stay with RWB-S6-E6008-APP; the award and the element read stay with the human roles of the Debt sale A right, whose role codes are Not specified in the source documents (GAP-3010).
